items.label: Yearly loan subsidy for small firms

footnote: Source: Ministry of Finance (January and August 2026). Illustration, AI-generated
notes: For manufacturers, equipment upgrades are the most direct and usable line this year. The 2026 budget puts ¥200 billion of ultra-long special bonds into large-scale equipment upgrades, and the Ministry of Finance said on August 21 that it had been allocated. Equipment purchases grew 11.8% in 2025, one of the few bright spots in investment. On financing, small and micro firms get a loan interest subsidy of 1.5 points a year for up to two years, and since August the subsidized amount per firm is up to ¥75 million, from ¥50 million. The AI Plus manufacturing action plan from January points the same way, so upgrades and automation can be planned together. The picture is an AI-generated illustration and shows no real factory.
